items.title: What’s Behind Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Stock’s Latest Move?
items.summary: The trigger for Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) is clear. Grand Theft Auto VI has delivered an estimated US$3.79b in day-one retail sales and 32.5 million pre-release units, setting a new entertainment launch record.
